pairs: being old and full of days,
regem constituit Salomonem filium suum super Israël.
appointed his son Solomon as king over Israel.
And he gathered together all the leaders of Israel,
with the priests as well as the Levites.
Numeratique sunt Levitæ a triginta annis et supra:
And the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward.
et inventa sunt triginta octo millia virorum.
And there were found thirty-eight thousand men.
et distributi in ministerium domus Domini,
and distributed to the ministry of the house of the Lord.
et totidem psaltæ, canentes Domino in organis quæ fecerat ad canendum.
And the same number were the singers of psalms to the Lord, with the musical instruments which he had made for the music.
Et distribuit eos David per vices filiorum Levi,
And David distributed them into courses according to the sons of Levi,
These were the leaders of the families of Ladan.
These were the sons of Shimei,
porro Jaus et Baria non habuerunt plurimos filios,
but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons,
et idcirco in una familia, unaque domo computati sunt.
and for this reason they were reckoned as one family and one house.
The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses.
Separatusque est Aaron ut ministraret in Sancto sanctorum, ipse et filii ejus in sempiternum,
Now Aaron was separated so that he might minister in the Holy of Holies, he and his sons forever,
et adoleret incensum Domino secundum ritum suum,
and so that he might burn incense to the Lord, according to his rite,
ac benediceret nomini ejus in perpetuum.
and so that he might bless his name in perpetuity.
Moysi quoque hominis Dei filii annumerati sunt in tribu Levi.
The sons of Moses, the man of God, were also numbered in the tribe of Levi.
Fuerunt autem filii Eliezer: Rohobia primus:
Now the sons of Eliezer were Rehabiah the first.
et non erant Eliezer filii alii.
And there were no other sons for Eliezer.
Porro filii Rohobia multiplicati sunt nimis.
But the sons of Rehabiah were multiplied exceedingly.
et non habuit filios, sed filias:
and had no sons, but only daughters.
acceperuntque eas filii Cis fratres earum.
And so the sons of Kish, their brothers, married them.
Hi filii Levi in cognationibus et familiis suis,
These are the sons of Levi, in their kindred and families,
principes per vices, et numerum capitum singulorum qui faciebant opera ministerii domus Domini,
leaders in turns, and the number of each of the heads who were doing the works of the ministry of the house of the Lord,
from twenty years of age and upward.
Requiem dedit Dominus Deus Israël populo suo,
the God of Israel, has given rest to his people,
et habitationem Jerusalem usque in æternum.
and a habitation in Jerusalem even unto eternity.
Nec erit officii Levitarum ut ultra portent tabernaculum et omnia vasa ejus ad ministrandum.
Neither shall it be the office of the Levites any more to carry the tabernacle with all its equipment for use in the ministry.”
supputabitur numerus filiorum Levi a viginti annis
according to the last precepts of David,
the sons of Levi shall be counted by number from twenty years of age and upward.
Et erunt sub manu filiorum Aaron in cultum domus Domini,
And they shall be under the hand of the sons of Aaron, in the care of the house of the Lord,
and in the place of purification,
et in universis operibus ministerii templi Domini.
and in all the works of the ministry of the temple of the Lord.
But the priests shall be over the bread of the presence,
and the sacrifice of fine wheat flour,
et super omne pondus atque mensuram.
Levitæ vero ut stent mane ad confitendum et canendum Domino:
Yet truly, the Levites shall stand to confess and to sing to the Lord, in the morning,
as much in the oblation of the holocausts of the Lord,
quam in sabbatis et calendis et solemnitatibus reliquis juxta numerum et cæremonias uniuscujusque rei,
as in the Sabbaths and new moons and other solemnities, according to the number and ceremonies for each and every matter,
And let them keep the observances of the tabernacle of the covenant,
and the rituals of the sanctuary,
et observationem filiorum Aaron fratrum suorum,
and the observance of the sons of Aaron, their brothers,
so that they may minister in the house of the Lord.
